method: Same LCMS CMYK16 to Lab double transform, relative colorimetric A2B1, NOOPTIMIZE|NOCACHE, no BPC on evaluation leg. Profile-predicted print Lab, not measured print or display-pixel differences. Quantiles linearly interpolated.
source_profile: Embedded HP1998 sRGB IEC61966-2.1, not assigned sRGB2014
sampling: All 262144 original pixels, byte to u16 times 257, no resize
provenance: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data#skimage.data.astronaut ; extracted image only from official scikit-image 0.25.2 PyPI wheel, NASA photograph, public domain per dataset documentation
